summary: While David hid from Saul, people in trouble gathered around him in a cave. Later, Jonathan found David in the wilderness and strengthened his faith in God, reminding him of God's promise.

story_reel.narration: David was now running for his life. He hid in a cave called Adullam. When his brothers and his father's family heard where he was, they came to join him. Then others came too: people who were in trouble, people who owed money, and people who were unhappy. About four hundred of them! David became their leader. Imagine a group of hurting, troubled people, and David taking care of them and leading them. Later, David hid in the wilderness, moving from place to place. Saul searched for him every day, but God didn't let Saul find him. One day, Jonathan came to see David in a forest at a place called Horesh. Jonathan didn't come with soldiers or weapons. He came to encourage his friend. The Bible says Jonathan 'strengthened David's hand in God.' He said, 'Don't be afraid. My father won't find you. You will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you. Even my father knows this.' Jonathan reminded David of God's promise. The two friends made their covenant again before Yahweh. Then Jonathan went home, and David stayed. Sometimes the best gift a friend can give is to point you back to God.

memory_verse.text: Let's consider how to provoke one another to love and good works

identity_focus.core_truth: I can point my friends back to Yahweh when they're struggling.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: Jonathan strengthened David's faith in God. How could you encourage a friend to trust God when things are hard?
reflection_choices: Remind them of a Bible verse

quiz.question: Where did David hide when he first ran from Saul?
quiz.explanation: David escaped to the cave of Adullam.

quiz.question: How many people in trouble gathered to David?
quiz.explanation: Everyone who was in distress, in debt, or discontented gathered to him, about four hundred men.

quiz.question: What did Jonathan do when he visited David in the forest?
options: He strengthened David's hand in God
quiz.explanation: Jonathan went to David and strengthened his hand in God.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, help me be the kind of friend who points others back to You. When my friends are scared or struggling, help me encourage them to trust You. Amen.

companion.message: When Jonathan found me in that forest, I was so tired and discouraged. He didn't bring a sword. He brought courage from God. That's what a true friend does.

review.notes: Omits Ahimelech and the massacre of the priests at Nob (1 Samuel 21-22). Confirm.
